host.timing_scope: informational shared-host timings; not a retention gate

stages.name: input-admission
stages.reason: check::check on the exact owned source graph

stages.name: certificate-construction
stages.reason: chained rewrite and certified prune transitions are produced by the proposal search

stages.name: certificate-wire-bytes
stages.reason: exact ngraph-cert/2 decimal-token envelope length is recorded; encoding time is not separately timed

stages.name: decoding-replay
stages.reason: decode_chained and check_chained re-derive each before/after graph state in one timed certificate-check stage

stages.name: candidate-admission
stages.reason: unchanged check::check consumes the exact certificate-checked pruned endpoint

stages.name: backend-preparation
stages.reason: Compiled::new from the independently admitted graph

stages.name: schedule-validation
stages.reason: packed_layout export plus layout::check on the object that executes; not instruction-byte correspondence

stages.name: first-execution
stages.reason: Compiled::evaluate with a fresh workspace after all admission stages succeed

stages.name: warm-execution
stages.reason: Compiled::evaluate_in reuses the accepted compiled object and workspace

stages.name: full-fresh-attempt
stages.reason: directly timed successful or refused baseline/certified pipeline; no sums of medians

stages.name: retained-memory
stages.reason: no allocator or RSS accounting; graph/code estimates and scratch lease observations are separately labeled

report.break_even: per-row linear estimate only for an executed quality-eligible candidate with positive measured warm saving; never inferred for refusals
report.cold_warm: fresh paired baseline/certified attempts reuse no admitted graph, compiled artifact or workspace; warm execution reuses the admitted artifact and workspace. Median and IQR over 200 samples after 64 priming iterations; not OS-cache-cold
report.comparison: raw-graph certificate component coverage is separate from full pipeline admission. Every executed candidate has exact ordered output agreement; refused cases retain their measured prefix cost and never execute a candidate. The chained wire decoder and checker share one measured checking stage. Baseline/certified paths use identical fixture inputs. No BLAKE3 deployment, Lean correspondence or allocator/RSS claim
